newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH SKODA SAYS HAS RECORD OUTPUT IN 1996.
newsitem.headline: CZECH SKODA SAYS HAS RECORD OUTPUT IN 1996.

text.p: Czech Skoda Auto a.s., majority-owned by Volkswagen AG, saw its 1996 production rise 26.3 percent, year-on-year, to a record 263,193 units, a company spokesman told Reuters on Monday.
Last year was the first full year of production of Skoda's flagship model, the Felicia compact.
Skoda also began production of its mid-size Octavia model in 1996, though less than 5,000 were produced.
Volkswagen took a minority stake in Skoda as part of the government's privatisation of the automaker, eventually increasing its holdings to a majority in 1995.
